items: WSFx Global Pay Limited received RBI Authorised Dealer Cat-II license under FEMA for trade remittances up to **₹25 lakh**.
⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on Authorized Dealer Category-II (AD-II) perpetual license terms, permissible non-trade current account transactions, and FEMA 1999 Section 10.
